comment: Weights are USER-SET taste. The ORDERING is Sam's (2026-06-13); magnitudes are left null because Sam has not rated them yet ('I don't know how to rate it') — the mirror proposes no numbers. general=1.0 is the spec-mandated catch-all. KEY DISTINCTION Sam drew: 'disciple' is a STATE OF BEING ('becoming like Christ in all I do') he ranks as infinite/highest — it is the FRAME over every other role, not a section competing for brief space; treat its weight as the apex/frame when the brief is built, not as a loud section. The calling 'ward-exec-sec' is a DISTINCT role: an ACT with tasks, not a state — lower than disciple. Ordinal: disciple(frame) >> husband-father > research > prod-admin > student; ward-exec-sec separate, lower than disciple, exact slot TBD. default_sensitivity 1 on disciple and ward-exec-sec = pastoral/ward content (third parties never consented; stays out of low-clearance packets).
